description: A Google Slides deck's structure with the object ids batch_update_presentation needs: per slide its layout, every element (shapes with type, placeholder and full text, images, tables cell by cell, lines, videos, Sheets charts, groups) with size and transform, and the speaker notes' shape id; plus layouts, masters and the page size. A shape's text is exact, so offset k is index k for insertText and text ranges. Sizes show as "3000000 EMU"; requests take {magnitude, unit}. A long deck is cut at a slide (`nextSlide`: read on with from_slide). format raw returns the API's JSON, narrowed by `fields`. Returns revisionId.

account.description: Which account: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Empty means the default account.

fields.description: format raw only: a field mask over the Presentation, e.g. "slides(objectId,pageElements(objectId,image))".

from_slide.description: The first slide to show, by position (0-based).

presentation_id.description: The presentation's id, or its URL.

slide_ids.description: Only these slides, by object id. Empty means every slide.

name: get_presentation
title: Read a deck's structure
